title: Target language conformance
summary: Agents writing, reviewing, or testing durable target-repository code MUST apply the target-derived language guidance this policy references together with the repository's configured toolchain.
instructions: Agents writing, reviewing, or testing code in a detected target language MUST read the guidance this policy references for that language before completion, and MUST apply it.
Agents MUST preserve the target repository's declared language version, formatter, type checker, test runner, module conventions, and dependency boundaries.
Verification commands MUST remain under REPO-001.
This guidance records conventions verified in the target repository. Where a referenced handbook states that no target-specific convention was found, agents MUST NOT invent one.
Workflow-local automation under runtime/logs/workflows/<run-id>/scripts/ MAY be throwaway and need not conform to this guidance unless it is promoted into durable repository code.
This policy and its referenced handbooks are generated by /pan-build-docs. Agents MUST NOT hand-edit them; they MUST regenerate the bundle when detected languages or target conventions change.
